build_autoencoder_kl_model: build an AutoencoderKL VAE model with configurable encoder and decoder block types and latent channels
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderKL encode method
decode_latents_to_images: decode a batch of latent vectors back into images using the AutoencoderKL decode method
tiled_encode_large_images: encode large images using tiled encoding to keep memory use constant regardless of image size
tiled_decode_large_latents: decode large latent tensors using tiled decoding to avoid seams between tiles
